title: Tally the arrivals
briefing: The guest log has the same names over and over. Who came most often?
tips: `sort` then `uniq -c` counts adjacent repeats; a second `sort -rn` ranks them.
objective: From ~/guests.txt, write to ~/tally.txt each name with how many times it appears, most frequent first.
hints: uniq only collapses ADJACENT duplicates, so sort the file first.
`sort guests.txt | uniq -c` counts each name; pipe into `sort -rn` to rank by count.
explanation: `sort | uniq -c | sort -rn` is the workhorse pipeline for 'what appears most?'. sort groups equal lines, uniq -c counts each group, and sort -rn floats the biggest counts to the top.
